steps.title: Payments to make in your own bank
steps.intro: SYB prepared these payments. SYB can't move money: you make each one yourself, in your own bank.
steps.howTitle: How to make each payment by hand:

hand.open: Open your bank's app or website and start a new transfer.
hand.copy: Copy the payee's name, IBAN and BIC exactly as written below.
hand.amount: Enter the amount and the reference, so the payee knows what it pays.
hand.confirm: Choose the date, check everything once more, then confirm the payment in your bank.
hand.mark: Back in SYB, press “Paid in my bank” so your records show it.

steps.erased: The bank details of this payment were erased. Ask the payee for them again.

why.bicNeeded: A bank outside the EEA needs the payee's BIC, so it isn't in the SEPA file: make it by hand.

steps.closing: Once a payment is made, mark it in SYB. If your bank refuses a detail, correct it there: SYB never sends anything to your bank.
